description:
Remote | UK Timezone | $26-35/hour EUR | Full-time

ABOUT YOKERU
Care is broken. Carers are stretched thin, buried in admin, making thousands of manual calls instead of actually caring for people who need them.

Yokeru was founded by two brothers after their grandmother waited 8 hours on the floor for help. We build AI voice agents that make thousands of calls in minutes — welfare check-ins, appointment reminders, device testing — so care teams can focus on the people who actually need them.

The impact so far:

  • 2.7 million connections supported
  • 5+ million calls per year
  • Trusted by the largest telecare organisations in Europe and the US

THE ROLE
We're hiring a hands-on Integrations Engineer to own how our AI agents connect to the outside world. You'll build and maintain the pipelines that move data between our platform and customer systems — reliably, at scale, in production.

High ownership. Flat structure, fast decisions. Real impact on vulnerable people's lives.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and build pipelines connecting our AI agents to customer data systems
  • Own the interfaces between Yokeru and third-party platforms via APIs and webhooks
  • Investigate logs, root-cause production issues, and resolve them fast
  • Join prospect and client calls to define integration requirements
  • Produce flow diagrams, integration specs, and technical documentation
  • Step into unfamiliar systems and map data flows independently

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Technical:

  • Strong software engineering foundation
  • Solid experience with APIs, webhooks, HTTP workflows, and data pipelines
  • Comfortable building integrations between SaaS platforms and custom systems
  • Log analysis and production debugging
  • Ability to build quickly and scale with resilience
  • Familiar with QA and deployment pipelines

How you work:

  • Takes full ownership end-to-end
  • Comfortable explaining technical concepts on customer calls
  • Fast learner who operates well in ambiguity
  • Highly organised and self-motivated
  • Genuinely cares about mission-driven work

ABOUT YOKERU
Founded by two brothers after their grandmother's fall. Bootstrapped to profitability over 7 years. Small team, big mission, zero bureaucracy.

Job Types: Full-time, Contract

Education: Bachelor's (Required)

Language: English (Required)

Work Location: Remote
